question: Given surviving center-to-center connections that are structurally equivalent before residual shape is inspected, is turn-rate or tortuosity mutation smaller when structural role is preserved than when role is broken?

matching.rule: Residual geometry is scored only after exact physical-family conditioning and a predeclared coarsened structural key is formed without turn rate or tortuosity.
matching.centerTypes: exact mapped endpoint/junction profile at both ends
matching.localDegree: exact mapped A/B endpoint degree profile after capping high degree
matching.parallelPathMultiplicity: A and B must have identical raw multiplicity before geometry is scored; the structural key carries a capped multiplicity class

residualGeometryFeatures.label: absolute difference between within-mapped-edge-bucket mean turn rate after structural matching
absolute difference between within-mapped-edge-bucket mean tortuosity after structural matching

aggregation.parallelPathRule: Do not pair parallel paths by geometry. For a surviving mapped center pair with equal multiplicity, reduce each side to its mean residual feature first.
aggregation.pairRule: Aggregate mapped edge buckets within each observation-pair + structural-key cell before comparing role labels.
aggregation.stratumRule: Within each physical-family + structural-key stratum compare preserved and broken observation pairs by smaller-is-more-conserved rank effect.
aggregation.familyRule: Average supported structural-stratum effects within each physical family pair, then average supported family-pair effects equally.

discovery.nullShuffle: shuffle preserved/broken observation-pair labels within each physical occupant-family pair while preserving the original preserved count
discovery.selection: none; both residual features are predeclared and reported

interpretation.collapse: If the Cleveland matched turn-rate effect has absolute magnitude below 0.08, classify the V5 turn-rate counter-signal as collapsed after structural matching and do not treat it as grammar evidence.
interpretation.residualConservation: If the matched effect is at least +0.08, residual path geometry is more conserved in role-preserving pairs beyond the matched wiring scaffold.
interpretation.persistentCounterSignal: If the matched effect is at most -0.08, the counter-direction persists after the predeclared structural conditioning.
interpretation.mixedFeatures: If turn rate and tortuosity separate materially, retain the distinction rather than collapsing path geometry into one grammar feature.

falsifiers.parentDrift: If the V5 manifest, edge world, projector rows, or role-pair rows fail their frozen hashes, abort.
falsifiers.v5Reproduction: If the exact V5 Cleveland turn-rate and tortuosity effects cannot be reproduced to the predeclared rounded tolerance, abort before corrected analysis.
falsifiers.insufficientSupport: If structural matching leaves no supported preserved/broken strata, report insufficient matched support rather than infer geometry.
falsifiers.noResidualSignal: If corrected geometry is near zero under the practical magnitude rule, remove the V5 geometry counter-signal from the grammar rather than explain it away.
